title: Linking protein corona composition to ecotoxicological outcomes: a comparative study of different engineered nanoparticles in Mediterranean sea urchin Paracentrotus lividus
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00836K, Paper
Patrizia Romano, Arianna Bellingeri, Marco Morelli, Rosanna Lucignano, Eugenio Paccagnini, Iole Venditti, Andrea Carpentieri, Pietro Lupetti, Ilaria Corsi, Serena Leone
Metal-based and polymeric nanoparticles acquire unique protein corona in the coelomic fluid of sea urchin Paracentrotus lividus, linking molecular fingerprints to in vitro biological responses.
